post.summary: Convert guest customer to registered customer
post.description: Converts an existing guest customer into a registered customer. If a password is provided, the customer can immediately log in using that password. If no password is provided, a password recovery email will be sent to the customer so they can set their password.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The id of the customer that should be converted.

requestBody.description: Optional data for the conversion process.

password.description: Optional password for the customer. If provided, the customer can log in immediately using this password. If omitted, a password recovery email will be sent.

204.description: Customer successfully converted to a registered customer.

401.description: The customer with the specified ID could not be found.

400.description: The customer is not a guest, or the sales channel domain could not be found.
